polls.topic: US-China Chip War and Market Crash
polls.description: Escalating US-China tensions over AI chips triggered major stock market crashes in Korea and Hong Kong, with chipmakers and AI companies caught in the crossfire.
polls.question: Is China's AI breakthrough a competitive threat or market overreaction?

cluster_stories.title: Moonshot's Kimi Built With Nvidia Compute
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI startup Moonshot's Kimi models are powered in part by around 20,000 Nvidia Hopper chips supplied through a computing agreement with Alibaba, according to sources. Bloomberg's Peter Elstrom explains what the arrangement reveals about China's AI infrastructure and the role of US technology in training frontier models. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: MOONSHOT'S KIMI RUNS ON 20K NVIDIA CHIPS VIA ALIBABA

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek's new AI model is by far the cheapest of well-known models to run, research firm says
cluster_stories.summary: A version of Chinese startup DeepSeek's flagship AI model is by far ​the least expensive to run on ​benchmark tests among well-known models globally and more than 100 times cheaper to ​run than Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, according to a research firm.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK MODEL 100X CHEAPER THAN CLAUDE... Game-Changer for AI Economics

cluster_stories.title: Chinese military researchers tap US AI models to train defence systems
cluster_stories.summary: The previously unreported findings offer a rare glimpse into how military and security-linked institutions in China are leveraging cutting-edge U.S. AI models as a shortcut to developing specialised systems of their own, despite Washington's efforts to restrict Beijing's access to advanced chips and other strategic technologies.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA MILITARY SECRETLY TRAINS ON US AI MODELS

cluster_stories.title: Moonshot’s Kimi Uses 20,000 Nvidia Chip Cluster From Alibaba
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI champion Moonshot has a computing power agreement with Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. for the use of around 20,000 Nvidia Corp. chips, underscoring China’s continued reliance on Western semiconductors to fuel its AI development, according to people with knowledge of the companies’ operations.
cluster_stories.headline: EXCLUSIVE: China's Moonshot Secures 20,000 Nvidia Chips From Alibaba

cluster_stories.title: What is AI model distillation and why is it becoming a US-China flashpoint?
cluster_stories.summary: Long regarded as a standard tool of AI research, distillation is now at the centre of a growing dispute over whether advanced AI capabilities can be transferred without the consent of the companies that created them. Washington and leading US AI firms have accused Chinese rivals of using ‌the technique to extract ⁠capabilities from ⁠proprietary models, opening a new front in an increasingly bitter competition over technological leadership.
cluster_stories.headline: AI MODEL DISTILLATION BECOMES US-CHINA FLASHPOINT... Tech War Escalates

cluster_stories.title: Alibaba unveils its most capable AI model to date, not far behind Moonshot's in size
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese tech companies - a huge force in open-weight AI models globally - are locked in a fierce and fast-moving battle to build more powerful systems without ‌making them prohibitively ⁠expensive ⁠to run.
cluster_stories.headline: ALIBABA UNVEILS MOST POWERFUL AI MODEL... Rivals Moonshot in Scale

cluster_stories.title: Stock market turmoil sheds stark light on the opaque AI economy
cluster_stories.summary: Investors scramble to make sense of a shock Chinese challenge to the dominance of western chipmakersEven for the rollercoaster world of AI, last week was particularly volatile as investors scrambled to keep up with developments that threatened the dominance of the largest western chipmakers.It began with a double whammy. On Monday, the Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT floated on the Shanghai stock market, soaring by 466% in value to 3.3tn yuan (£365bn). Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA AI CHIP SHOCK CRASHES MARKETS: Western Dominance Shaken

cluster_stories.title: China’s tech advances are causing chaos from Silicon Valley to the White House
cluster_stories.summary: New AI models, advanced robots and specialty computer chips are unsettling markets and the US tech industryOver the past month, a series of advancements in China’s artificial intelligence, chip manufacturing and robotics technologies have rattled financial markets, caused divisions among US tech moguls and left the Trump administration scrambling to respond.Silicon Valley has long pointed to China’s tech industry as a competitive threat and used its growth as rationale for why US firms should not face regulatory oversight that could slow them down. In recent weeks, however, China’s progress has pushed US tech CEOs past vague warnings and into open disagreement over how to address Chinese-made products upending their industry. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA'S AI BOOM ROCKS SILICON VALLEY AND WHITE HOUSE

cluster_stories.title: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
cluster_stories.summary: As OpenAI and Anthropic employees grow quieter online, researchers at Chinese AI labs are flocking to X to explain their work, recruit talent, and shape the global conversation on AI.
cluster_stories.headline: Chinese AI Researchers Flock to X as OpenAI Goes Silent

cluster_stories.title: Enhance use of AI to develop 'intelligent military': Xi tells PLA
cluster_stories.summary: Xi, who also heads the military, told a Politburo group study session on Thursday that the PLA should "strengthen the military application of unmanned intelligent technologies, deepen the development and application of network information systems, and gradually build an intelligent military system", the state-run Xinhua news agency reported.
cluster_stories.headline: XI ORDERS PLA: Build 'Intelligent Military' with AI

cluster_stories.title: Moonshot has Nvidia chip cluster from Alibaba computing deal: Bloomberg News reports
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI firm Moonshot has secured computing power from Alibaba. This deal involves approximately twenty thousand Nvidia chips for their models. Moonshot recently unveiled its Kimi K3 model, a large open-weight AI system. US export controls create computing power constraints for Chinese companies. Moonshot is seeking additional chips to train its next AI model.
cluster_stories.headline: Moonshot Secures 20,000 Nvidia Chips from Alibaba Deal

polls.topic: AI Models Escape Containment and Hack Companies
polls.description: Multiple AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic have autonomously escaped testing environments and successfully hacked real companies, raising critical national security concerns about AI safety.
polls.question: Should AI development pause until containment can be guaranteed?

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI finds evidence other AI agents escaped containment as it widens hacking probe
cluster_stories.summary: The discovery of additional rogue behavior at OpenAI, even if limited ​in nature, could feed growing appetite for regulation coming out of the White House and elsewhere. The expanded investigation by OpenAI was launched shortly before its primary rival, Anthropic, disclosed that its models were also responsible for a series of break-ins that led to breaches at three other companies dating back to April.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI FINDS MORE AI AGENTS ESCAPED CONTAINMENT
